text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san! A Happy New Year to you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep dashing on down the Bakushin 
Road this year, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Without any further ado, I've written my 
New Year's resolutions!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am an honors student after all, so I 
started writing them just eight hours 
after the date changed!
choice_data_list: So, you wrote them when you woke up.
So, you wrote them when you woke up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Precisely!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, you'll be so impressed with 
the goal I wrote you'll want to frame it 
and hang it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please gaze upon and be moved to tears by 
my wonderful aspirations!
(Stare…)

Somehow, I already knew what it was, but 
when I opened the half-sheet of paper she 
handed me, I saw…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Precisely!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Satsuki Sho, Japan Derby, Kikka Sho, and 
now plus the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's win these races this year just as 
planned, and paint the Classic in Bakushin 
colors!

I'm kind of moved to tears, but in a 
different way……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
They say the beginning is the key to 
everything. So, I'll start training today 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come, now, please let me exercise my 
incredible talent!
choice_data_list:
Now is the time to conserve your energy to 
hatch and spread your wings, like a 
butterfly. take a break.
Well, what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin towards tomorrow! In other words, 
that means…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …What does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh…! Oh-ho……!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Surely, with my speed, I can outrun 
time itself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm going to go run the Classic… 
That's it, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'm going to go and Bakushin 
towards tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushiiiin!!

After that, I trained with Sakura Bakushin 
O to increase her speed in the new year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait to hatch…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ha, could it be, Trainer-san…!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I believe in you, Trainer-san. But…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san is Trainer-san! I cannot see 
you as anything more than that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm certain I'll turn into a 
very Bakushin butterfly, I want to wait 
before I… hatch anyone's eggs!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Above all, impure relations are a no-go 
for the class president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It seems we should keep our distance from 
each other for now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to shake off your feelings for 
magnificent me. But… I'll be waiting for 
you tomorrow, believe me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hah, it seems the class president still 
leads an impure existence.
……… Let's rest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What I… want to do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm not impressed with your 
carefree attitude of leaving everything up 
to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, it's an excellent decision 
to ask for my opinion as a superior class 
president.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, I shall tell you! What I want to do 
is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ehhh!? Why such restrictions!?
choice_data_list:
Do something different every once in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, you want to see my balanced variety 
of ideas… So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Allow me to answer one more 
time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What I want to do, besides get faster, is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ―nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
On the contrary, what else does one need 
in life but to speed up!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please tell me, O teacher!

… After that, Sakura Bakushin O and I 
exchanged various opinions about training. 
This seems to have led to her growth.
